messages:
emma: Quick heads-up — we're rolling out a graduated quota-exemption policy for short high-burst usage patterns and shifting the invoice generation window by +4h for the next two billing cycles to smooth meter spikes. No customer will see unexpected charges today; this is a timing/soft-grace change, not an across-the-board price hike.

michael: can you clarify which customers get the exemption and how long?

emma: good q. exemption is automatic for accounts with burst windows < 1h and 95th-percentile sustained usage below their tier for the last 7 days. Exemption applies to route-level soft-burst overages (we'll waive the first 2 burst events per 30d).

linda: is this only hosted customers or also Dedicated/Private?

emma: hosted + Dedicated. Private deployments are subject to their contract; we'll provide an opt-in script for on-prem teams but not automatic.

raj: any change to free credits allocation? customers asking.

emma: short answer: free credits unchanged. We are extending the timeline for how credits are consumed against burst events — credits will be applied before evaluating exemption for the next two cycles.

billing-bot: Scheduled invoice job updated: old_cron=UTC 00:00 -> new_cron=UTC 04:00 for billing cycles starting 2026-05-01.

sarah-sales: heads-up for AE queue — invoices may land ~4h later for customers in EMEA. Please avoid escalating unless >24h delay. I'll add a note to the customer-facing KB.

ops-mon: any risk to metering pipelines? we saw lag last month when we moved ingestion windows.

michael: pinging infra — we'll throttle back the scan window and add a short retry buffer. No schema changes, just window shift.

linda: will there be a banner/announcements email? some large partners want a heads-up 7 days prior.

emma: yes — public blog + customer email + in-console banner. Drafts in #marketing will be ready by EOD tomorrow.

raj: can we get a sample invoice snippet to send to partners?

emma: pasted small example (sensitive fields redacted):

```
Invoice Date: 2026-05-01
Account: ACCT-XXXX
Usage Window: 2026-04-01 -> 2026-04-30
Invoice Generation: UTC 04:00
LineItems:
 - Hosted tokens: 1,234,567
 - Burst waiver (2 events): -$12.00
 - Credits applied: -$50.00
 Total: $1,234.00
```

billing-bot: Note: customers will see adjusted billing window in account settings > Billing > Billing window.

sarah-sales: thanks — I'll coordinate partner comms and include the waiver language.

emma: tl;dr: graduated burst exemptions (auto for short burst profiles), invoice generation moved +4h for two cycles, free credits unaffected, Dedicated gets auto for hosted/Dedicated, Private is opt-in. Ping me for edge cases. :wave:

ops-mon: noted. will watch metering dashboards the two cycles after rollout. :eyes:
thread_text_searchable: graduated quota exemption invoice window +4h burst waiver hosted Dedicated Private credits unaffected customer comms
